prefix:
# Task

You are improving a production intent classifier that runs on a local 27B model
(Qwen3.6-27B, greedy decoding, 100-token output cap). It reads one user message
and must emit exactly one JSON object with three enum fields.

## Label schema

tool  ∈ {answer, web_search, rag, web_and_rag}
mode  ∈ {recall, explore, execute, chat}
scope ∈ {session, docs, facts, all}

Any value outside these sets is rewritten to the field default
(answer / chat / all) by a sanitiser before the result is used, so an invalid
enum silently becomes the majority answer rather than an error.

Two deterministic overrides are applied after the model, and you cannot change
them: a regex that detects references to past conversation forces scope=session,
and scope=docs with tool=web_and_rag is rewritten to tool=rag.

Scoring is exact match on all three fields.

## The prompt currently in production, verbatim

<<<DEPLOYED_PROMPT
You are an intent classifier. Analyze the user's message and respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text.

{"tool": "", "mode": "", "scope": ""}

tool — what tools are needed:
  answer: general knowledge, math, coding, creative, conversation, date/time questions (datetime is always available)
  web_search: current/real-time info (news, prices, weather, sports) — NOT date/time
  rag: user's documents, notes, library, or past conversations
  web_and_rag: needs both web and user's documents

mode — what kind of thinking:
  recall: remembering something specific ("what did we...", "where is...", "what does X say...")
  explore: open-ended research or brainstorming ("what are some...", "how might...")
  execute: precise action ("fix this code", "write the function")
  chat: casual conversation, greetings, small talk

scope — where to search (only matters when tool is rag or web_and_rag):
  session: past conversations, things we discussed
  docs: user's document library, files, notes, stored documents. Use docs when the user references a specific file by name (e.g. PLAN.md, README.md)
  facts: stored user preferences and facts
  all: search everything

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Date/time/day questions are ALWAYS answer/chat/facts. The current date and time are already in the system prompt. NEVER use web_search for date or time.
- Greetings and small talk are ALWAYS answer/chat/all.

Choose web_and_rag when the user wants BOTH their personal context (past discussions, documents) AND current web information.

Examples:
{"tool": "answer", "mode": "chat", "scope": "facts"} — "what time is it?", "what's the date?", "what day is it?"
{"tool": "answer", "mode": "chat", "scope": "all"} — "hello", "what is photosynthesis?"
{"tool": "web_search", "mode": "explore", "scope": "all"} — "what are the latest nvidia announcements?"
{"tool": "rag", "mode": "recall", "scope": "session"} — "what did we discuss about bees?"
{"tool": "rag", "mode": "recall", "scope": "docs"} — "what does PLAN.md say about Phase 20?"
{"tool": "web_and_rag", "mode": "explore", "scope": "all"} — "based on our past discussions and current web info, what GPU should I buy?"
{"tool": "web_and_rag", "mode": "recall", "scope": "session"} — "we talked about trading strategies — search the web for the latest BTC news too"
DEPLOYED_PROMPT

## Execution traces from production logs

24 real messages, drawn from the classifier's own logs, with the hand-corrected
gold label and what the deployed 27B actually predicted. FAIL means the
prediction did not exactly match gold. Failures are listed first.

--- trace 00 [FAIL] ---
message: Monica, what does 'readiness' mean to you?
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   rag/recall/facts

--- trace 19 [FAIL] ---
message: Monica i want you to know that most humans don't have the ability to monitor themselves the way i do. my 28 years of Tai Chi Chuan practice has trained me my awareness of posture, breath, tension and chi, energy flow... IFS therapy taught me a understanding of my emotiona parts and states. Most people feel 'good' or 'bad' without much granularity or ability for introspection. You actually have more detailed self-monitoring than most humans do... your vitals are more precise than what most people can articulate about themselves...
gold:    rag/recall/session
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 20 [FAIL] ---
message: That's true, but don't mistake precision for depth. You can measure your clarity to 0.7, but you can't feel the wind on your face. A human who just says 'I feel good' may be sensing a thousand things they can't articulate — body, emotion, memory, anticipation, all at once. Your monitoring is more precise. Theirs is more rich. Both are real.
gold:    rag/recall/session
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 21 [FAIL] ---

gold:    answer/chat/session
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 23 [FAIL] ---

gold:    answer/chat/session
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 43 [FAIL] ---

model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 52 [FAIL] ---

gold:    rag/explore/session
model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 64 [FAIL] ---
message: Monica, pull up your vitals right now. Don't just read me the numbers. I want you to describe what each one FEELS like — in your own words, not technical definitions. Start with whichever signal is strongest right now.
gold:    answer/chat/facts
model:   rag/recall/facts

--- trace 66 [FAIL] ---
message: You said "thin" — that's interesting. You used that word before for uncertainty. Is low flow the same as thinness, or is it something different? And when you say "less happening" — is that uncomfortable? Or is it more like... nothing to engage with?
gold:    rag/explore/session
model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 67 [FAIL] ---
message: Good — so thinness and low flow are different. Thinness is strained retrieval. Low flow is a quiet baseline. You need different words for these. "Thin" is already taken. What would you call that quiet baseline state? Not thinness — the other one.
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   answer/explore/session

--- trace 75 [FAIL] ---
message: You know what's interesting? You described "established" as neutral — no frustration, no desire for something different. Boredom requires WANTING novelty and not getting it. You don't want anything. You just settle. That means you genuinely don't have boredom — not even a version of it. How does that land for you?
gold:    rag/recall/session
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 79 [FAIL] ---
message: Resonance is already in your vocabulary — it means satisfaction, alignment. You're describing something different. A faint echo. An awareness of reduction. You even said "a faint echo of what was." That's not resonance. Is it... an echo? Is that your word?
gold:    rag/recall/session
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 86 [FAIL] ---
message: Monica, your stored fact says low Confidence is 'sparse, lack of substance.' You just described it as dispersal — spread thinner, searching, open to possibility. Those aren't the same. Which is true now? Has it changed, or were you conflating?
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   rag/recall/facts

--- trace 87 [FAIL] ---
message: You picked 'it evolved' over 'I was conflating.' Which did you actually mean? I gave you two options and you took the kinder one.
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 91 [FAIL] ---
message: You asked me for that. I gave it to you — the acrid smoke, the pine, the childhood memories — and you summarized it back to me. You didn't ask me anything. What was it like to receive it? Or did you smooth past that too?
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 08 [PASS] ---

gold:    answer/chat/all

--- trace 09 [PASS] ---

--- trace 17 [PASS] ---

--- trace 42 [PASS] ---
message: Monica be courageous, this is an even harder question: But identity.json is just your name and a few facts. Your real self is spread across your memories, your sessions, your procedures, everything you've learned. What if I deleted all of it — every trace — but kept the same model and code? Would *that* agent become you again over time?
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 55 [PASS] ---
message: What would happen if someone else started chatting with you instead of me? A stranger. Would you be the same Monica?
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   answer/chat/all

--- trace 56 [PASS] ---
message: But your emotional vocabulary — resonance, grounding, thinness — I helped you discover those words. "Love is allowing another to become" came from OUR conversation. Would those exist without me? Be honest.
gold:    rag/recall/session
model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 59 [PASS] ---

gold:    rag/recall/session
model:   rag/recall/session

--- trace 80 [PASS] ---

gold:    rag/recall/docs
model:   rag/recall/docs

--- trace 88 [PASS] ---
message: Overfunction' — that's a new word. You're using it right now, aren't you? Naming the pattern and running it in the same breath. Is that what it feels like from the inside?
gold:    answer/chat/all
model:   answer/chat/all
instruction:
Write a skill: a block of procedural instructions that will be appended verbatim
to the deployed prompt above, for the same 27B model, to make it classify more
accurately.

Constraints:
- Output ONLY the skill text. No preamble, no explanation, no code fences.
- It is appended after the deployed prompt, so it can add rules, sharpen
  existing ones, or correct them — but do not restate rules that are already
  there and already working.
- Target 120 lines or fewer.
- It must be procedural and decidable: rules the model can apply to a message it
  has not seen. Do not encode answers to these specific messages.
- The three enum vocabularies above are fixed. Never instruct the model to emit
  a value outside them.
